address: 2265 N University Pkwy, Provo, UT 84604, United States

reviewText:
So far I’ve only tried their shaved ice, Bahama-Rama-Mama (ice cream) style, but I love it!!!

The service is friendly and great, the restaurant is clean and enjoyably decorated.

Bahama Buck’s is one of my top go-to places to get a tasty treat with a friend. I highly recommend them.

*If you found my review helpful, I would greatly appreciate a thumbs up (like) so google and I know. Thanks, and Bon appétit!
